rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the system or structure by which a state or religious body is governed.

example.english: The polity of this religious group is quite complex.
example.traditional: 呢個宗教團體嘅政治制度比較複雜。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zung1 gaau3 tyun4 tai2 ge3 zing3 zi6 zai3 dou6 bei2 gaau3 fuk1 zaap6

rows.note: Use this when the polity means a nation-state or country rather than a governing system.

example.english: The people of this polity live quite peacefully.
example.traditional: 呢個國家嘅人民生活得幾安穩。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 jan4 man4 sang1 wut6 dak1 gei2 on1 wan2

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on the ruling power or regime that governs the political unit.

example.english: After the new polity came to power, it immediately amended the constitution.
example.traditional: 新政權上台之後，立即修改咗憲法。
example.jyutping: san1 zing3 kyun4 soeng5 toi4 zi1 hau6 lap6 zik1 sau1 goi2 zo2 hin3 faat3
